bug_catcher.name: Bug Catcher
dialog: Eterna Forest is full of Poison Pokémon, and I haven't bought a single Antidote.
Do I go on? Do I go back? ...I've been standing here an hour.

trainer.name: Jacob
trainer.dialogueBefore: Camper Jacob: I'm heading into Eterna Forest. How about a battle before I go?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Camper Jacob: They say the Pokémon in the forest are tougher than this. I'd better get ready.

trainer.name: Daniel
trainer.dialogueBefore: Hiker Daniel: Not a mountain in sight, and here I am in my boots. Gahaha! Come on, then!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Hiker Daniel: Now that cleared the head! You find the same Pokémon in the oddest places, you know.

trainer.name: Elizabeth
trainer.dialogueBefore: Aroma Lady Elizabeth: I adore a Pokémon with a sweet scent. Here, come and smell this one!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Aroma Lady Elizabeth: Plant enough Berries and you can live in sweet scents all year round.

trainer.name: Zackary
trainer.dialogueBefore: Camper Zackary: It's a long road from Floaroma to Eterna City. A battle will shorten it!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Camper Zackary: Camping out with your Pokémon. Have you any idea how good that is?

trainer.name: Siena
trainer.dialogueBefore: Picnicker Siena: I wonder which Pokémon live round here. Shall we find out?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Picnicker Siena: I know lots about Pokémon! Some are male, some are female, and some are neither.

trainer.name: Nicholas
trainer.dialogueBefore: Hiker Nicholas: I've lost my way. Here, of all places...
trainer.dialogueAfter: Hiker Nicholas: I spent so long lost in the mountains that I turned into a hiker.

trainer.name: Kelsey
trainer.dialogueBefore: Battle Girl Kelsey: Hi-yah! I'm not holding anything back!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Battle Girl Kelsey: Hi-yah! You showed me how far I have to go. Thank you!

trainer.name: Karina
trainer.dialogueBefore: Picnicker Karina: Hmm, I don't know. Shall I play with you for a bit?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Picnicker Karina: Stand quite still and listen. Can you hear the Pokémon calling?

signs.trainer_tips_signpost:
Trainer Tips
Whatever you pick up goes into the right pocket of your Bag by itself.
